title: Everyday Phrases — At the Beach
scene_zh: 海灘一日 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏖️ 實用海灘必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Beach
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用海灘情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從到達海灘停車租傘找位子、下水游泳衝浪與玩浮圈，到沙灘排球、蓋沙堡、撿貝殼，最後沖洗更衣、吃冰淇淋看日落再回家，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Beach phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), following a full beach day: arriving, parking and renting an umbrella, swimming, surfing and floating, then volleyball, sandcastles and shell collecting, and finally beach showers, ice cream, sunset and the drive home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I see the beach ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the sea looks so blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you carry the cooler box?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a ticket here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's at the little hut.
dialogue.zh: 可以，就在那邊的小木屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One umbrella for the whole day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a beach mat too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə bitʃ mæt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, take this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's find a spot in the shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts faɪnd ə spɑt ɪn ðə ʃeɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How about near the palm trees?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it deep into the sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind is a bit strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些椅子現在是我們的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set up the beach tent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our spot close to water?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we keep our shoes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And on the back of my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɑn ðə bæk ʌv maɪ nɛk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is really hot today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are the big beach towels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we can just sit here.
dialogue.zh: 現在可以舒舒服服坐下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at all the people here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put on sunscreen every two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's bury our feet in sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll buy lemonade at the stand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water is up to my waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər ɪz ʌp tu maɪ weɪst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wave just hit my face!
dialogue.zh: 一個浪剛好打在我臉上！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你嚐到海水的味道了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to jump over one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow your float ring?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe to swim here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, but I want to try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 今天海面看起來好平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, now I see one too!
dialogue.zh: 噢，我現在也看到一條了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's like lying on a cloud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears are full of water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 低著頭跳一跳就會出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a break from waves.
dialogue.zh: 我要休息一下，不跟浪玩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's go back into the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got you with a big splash!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you float on your own?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a cramp in my toe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kræmp ɪn maɪ toʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that big wave?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 哎唷，有什麼東西螫到我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will cool water help the sting?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's swim close to the shore.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose is full of water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我知道，剛剛不小心嗆到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun feels great in the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn filz ɡreɪt ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't want to check that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the water brown there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊的水為什麼是褐色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix my goggles strap?
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我弄泳鏡帶子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear the whistle again?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay in ten more minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi steɪ ɪn tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再待十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's warm up on the beach.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我冷得牙都打顫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun will dry us fast.
dialogue.zh: 太陽一下子就把我們曬乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to our spot on the sand.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tu ˈaʊər spɑt ɑn ðə sænd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lie down and get some sun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那場比賽看起來好好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to try it too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just hit it over the net.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How big do we make it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack the sand in the bucket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The castle needs to be strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put a flag on the castle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, this one is white and pink!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðɪs wʌn ɪz waɪt ænd pɪŋk!/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll keep them in my hat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we keep the big starfish?
dialogue.zh: 那隻大海星可以帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it lives in the sea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shell looks like an ear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And this one is smooth and round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs wʌn ɪz smuð ænd raʊnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can make a shell picture.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們撿一些很酷的石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool, I'll fill my other hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It dug a hole so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find a good shell?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們用沙子把它擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 撿了滿滿一帽子帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the pools in the rocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə pulz ɪn ðə rɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm glad we picked it up.
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們把它撿乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's clean up our sand toys.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But it washes off the sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is full of sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet it and comb it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在那棟白色小房子後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a plastic bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't find my left shoe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can smell the ice cream!
dialogue.zh: 我聞到冰淇淋的香味了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go before the line grows.
dialogue.zh: 快過去，趁排隊的人還不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One big chocolate cone for me.
dialogue.zh: 我要一個大巧克力甜筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a small vanilla cup for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə smɔl vəˈnɪlə kʌp fər mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! Have a nice day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 它順著我的手滴下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I try one little bite?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a gull wants your cone.
dialogue.zh: 看，有海鷗想吃你的甜筒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the view is great.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the sunset is painting the sky.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðə ˈsʌnˌsɛt ɪz ˈpeɪntɪŋ ðə skaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 哇，夕陽正在幫天空上色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sun is going down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay until the very last light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole sky is on fire.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the long shadows now.
dialogue.zh: 看現在拉得好長的影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 連浪看起來都是金色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take one more photo?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with the sunset behind us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car keys are all wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is in the trunk now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the night wind feels nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can hear the night waves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring my swim cap too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 真的，在馬路上都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be tired at work tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beach tired is the best kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag smells like the sea.
dialogue.zh: 我的包包聞起來像大海。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take off your beach shoes here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, they go in the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we watch the beach photos?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以看海灘的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then plan the next trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we do this next weekend?
dialogue.zh: 下週末可以再來這麼玩一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, I still hear the waves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, aɪ stɪl hɪr ðə weɪvz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, best beach day ever.
